diagnostics.message: Since Python 3.14, asyncio.get_event_loop() raises RuntimeError when no event loop is set instead of creating one, and asyncio.set_event_loop() only sets the loop that call returns. Start the loop with asyncio.run() or asyncio.Runner at the entry point, and get it with asyncio.get_running_loop() inside a coroutine or a callback.
